notes: Exalted: The Fair Folk supplied and reviewed cover to cover. 263 rows reviewed and inventoried under docs/references/exalted1e/fair-folk/inventory/: the character-creation overview (split into separate common- and noble-raksha rows), the four base castes (Diplomat/Entertainer/Warrior/Worker), the twelve named noble hybrid castes, the five Graces (Cup/Ring/Staff/Sword/Heart) with their forging rules, the Bedlam mechanic (the raksha's Limit-Trait analog) including all four Virtue-specific Curses, the five new Backgrounds (Birth/Freehold/Gossamer/Retinue/Style), the altered Backgrounds (Artifact/Familiar/Manse/Backing-Contacts-Influence) and the excluded ones (Followers/Resources), the core signature mechanics (Wyld-damage immunity, Craft (Glamour), Wyld Stunts/Bonuses, Gossamer-and-Glamour, Mutation, Shaping Actions/Reality Shaping, Shaping Combat basics, Oaths, Cold-Wrought Iron), all of Chapter Five: Raksha Magic end to end (all five per-Grace Charm trees, the universal Assumption-type Charm tree, the Vexing/Questing rules, Glamour Sorcery/Wyld Artifacts/Adjurations/Behemoths, and the narrowly-scoped sixth shinma Nirupadhika), and now a triage pass across the remaining Chapters One/Two/Six/Seven that found and added the two remaining genuinely player-facing items (the Gossamer Manta vehicle and the post-creation Experience and Training Time table) and definitively confirmed, via an exhaustive book-wide text search, that Fair Folk has no dedicated Merits/Flaws section anywhere in the book. Nothing promoted to a production catalog yet. Chapter Six's Mountain Folk (a wholly separate playable-adjacent race with its own extensive character creation) was deliberately not inventoried here -- out of Fair Folk (raksha) scope. Locked pending schema/rules/creator/editor implementation and passing tests across all five planned families.
